threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'going to the park' means Clissold. Meanwhile, the locals are all about Abney Park's hidden charms and the graveyard’s peace.
Caught a snippet of a guy on the N68 claiming he knows a secret way to dodge the strikes. Reckoned it’s not all about the trains, just the right folk to ask.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I found a small café with the best türkischer Mokka, and the barista remembers my name. That warm nod feels like family.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, there’s a spontaneous techno party in a public toilet every summer. Just a guy with a speaker and a whole crowd vibing.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their reaction to a BART delay—it's not frustration, it's a resigned chuckle and a shrug, like, 'What else is new?'

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a three-piece suit playing sax on the bus today, competing with the Bluetooth speaker of someone blasting reggaeton. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia's plazas are just for selfies, but locals use them for daily life—catching up, relaxing, or even doing homework.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their puzzled look when asked for directions—especially if they still think the metro is straightforward.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still instinctively check your phone for tube updates when you hear a train rumble, instead of just bracing for delays like the rest of us.
Last night on the 68, a guy serenaded the whole bus with a ukulele version of 'Wonderwall.' Even the driver was tapping the wheel!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a glimpse of a street artist painting a mural while locals gathered for impromptu karaoke. That's when it hit me - this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can order a currywurst at 3 AM, and the stand guy will still chat with you about the latest club openings. That’s Berlin hustle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they never bother to find a new route when BART's down. They just roll with the bus delays like it’s another Wednesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a broken air conditioning in this heat. The driver just shrugged and said, 'Welcome to San Francisco.' Only here can discomfort feel like home.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all of Gràcia is a constant fiesta, but many locals just want their bocata and a quiet corner to enjoy it.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their puzzlement at the lack of a queue at the bakery—natives know that the best pastries disappear fast.
